label: Kotlin (JVM)
note: Kotlin/JVM classes run on HotSpot with tiered compilation and G1. Each sample includes JVM startup, class loading, runtime compilation, input/output and shutdown. Authored helpers are included in source counts.
memory_policy: G1 explicitly selected; initial heap 64 MiB, maximum heap 8 GiB. The process RSS limit is separately enforced at 10 GiB.
execution_scope: JIT identifies the HotSpot execution mode. An individual main or method can remain interpreted during a single process. No warmup or extra main invocation precedes a measured sample.
compilation_outside_timer: Kotlin source compilation to the retained JVM class artifacts
compilation_inside_timer: HotSpot tiered runtime compilation during each fresh JVM process
runtime_evidence_scope: Compiler version and JDK identity are retained toolchain evidence. JVM flags are required in each timed launch; this metadata does not claim an extra diagnostic probe inside every timed process.
